}}'''Asne Zeramene''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Green Ajah]] and secretly a member of the [[Black Ajah]].{{ref/book|c|Asne Zeramene}} She was a part of [[Liandrin's Group of Black Sisters|Liandrin's group of Black sisters]].

== Appearance ==
Asne was a typical [[Saldaean]] with a bold nose and tilted eyes. She dressed modestly for a Saldaean, but was as bold as any other. She was 5'4" tall.

==Strength and Abilities==
Asne was of [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|high average]] strength for an Aes Sedai, with a [[One Power]] level of {{opsl|24}}. She is stronger than the minimum stated strength needed to [[Traveling|Travel]].

== History ==
She was from [[Saldaea]].

She was Aes Sedai for over a hundred and thirty years. Born in {{ne|837}}, she went to the Tower in {{ne|853}}. After seven years as a novice and eight as Accepted, she was raised in {{ne|868}}.

She had four [[Warders]]. Only one of them, [[Powl]], was a [[Darkfriend]], but she was confident the other three would believe what she told them and do anything she ordered.{{ref/book|9|10}}

== Activities==
After fleeing the [[White Tower]], she and the others in [[Liandrin]]'s group went to [[Tear]] and worked for the [[Forsaken]] [[Be'lal]]. They tried, unsuccessfully, to trap [[Rand al'Thor]] just after he released ''[[Callandor]]''. After this failure, the group fled to [[Tanchico]] to try and steal the [[Domination Band]] from the [[Panarch's Palace]]. They were foiled by [[Elayne Trakand]] and [[Nynaeve al'Meara]].

After Tanchico, they went to [[Amadicia]] where [[Moghedien]] took charge of the group.{{ref/book|5|18}} After Liandrin's punishment and [[Eldrith Jhondar|Eldrith Jhondar's]] promotion, Moghedien ordered [[Temaile Kinderode]] to Ghealdan. Asne traveled to [[Samara]] with Temaile, Eldrith, and [[Chesmal Emry]]. When Eldrith's Warder [[Kennit]] arrived, they fled to [[Caemlyn]].{{ref/book|9|10}} Asne had found the [[fluted black rod]], which Moghedien had hidden, and brought it with her.

After fleeing Samara, Asne stopped masking her Warder [[bond]] so that her [[Warders]] could find her. She intended to keep the presence of her Warders a secret, holding them in reserve in case she needed protection.{{ref/book|9|10}}

She walked in on Elayne, [[Vandene Namelle]], [[Sareitha Tomares]], and [[Careane Fransi]] trying to arrest [[Lady Shiaine]], [[Falion Bhoda]], and [[Marillin Gemalphin]]. Asne stunned them with a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' that she probably found when she pilfered the fluted black rod.{{ref/book|11|31}}{{ref/book|11|33}} Vandene, Sareitha, and Careane were all killed and Elayne was taken captive.

Working with Chesmal, [[Falion Bhoda]], Temaile, [[Marillin Gemalphin]], Eldrith, and Lady Shiaine, Asne attempted to flee from Caemlyn with Elayne. However, they were confronted by Andoran soldiers organized by Birgitte to rescue Elayne. Asne slaughtered many of the soldiers using [[balefire]] produced by the fluted black rod ''ter'angreal''. Shortly thereafter, Birgitte persuaded the [[Windfinders]] to intervene and so Asne was killed by lightning thrown by a circle led by [[Chanelle]]. Three of her Warders, including [[Powl]],{{ref/book|c|Powl}} were bound with [[Air]] and almost certainly imprisoned.{{ref/book|11|33}}{{ref|Asne's fourth Warder was probably killed during the skirmish, or perhaps was sent elsewhere prior to the skirmish.}}
